entities.summary: Lydia Seyram Alhassan is a Ghanaian politician and member of the Seventh Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana. She represented the Ayawaso West Wuogon Constituency in the Greater Accra Region on the ticket of the New Patriotic Party.
